english.title: Helicopter operator or pilot in command on Performance Class 3 operation flying for more than 3 minutes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a helicopter, namely **(..SPECIFY HELICOPTER..), registered in the United Kingdom which flew in the specified circumstances on a flight for more than three minutes other than with the permission in writing of the CAA, while carrying out a Performance Class 3 operation, being equipped with the required apparatus and flying under and in accordance with the terms of a national air operator's certificate
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 129(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator or pilot in command of a helicopter registered in the United Kingdom
carrying out a Performance Class 3 operation
which was equipped with the required apparatus
and was flying under and in accordance with the terms of a national air operator's certificate
and flew in the specified circumstances on a flight for more than three minutes other than with the permission in writing of the CAA

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) 'Specified circumstances' means, in respect of a helicopter, circumstances in which it is more than 20 seconds flying time from a point from which it can make an autorotative descent to land suitable for an emergency landing
